Title: What is Amazon Kendra?
Content: Amazon Kendra is an intelligent enterprise search service powered by machine learning. It allows you to search across different content repositories with built-in connectors.

Title: How is Kendra priced?
Content: Amazon Kendra offers two editions: Developer Edition for building and testing, and Enterprise Edition for production workloads. Pricing is based on the number of documents indexed and queries made.

Title: What file formats does Kendra support?
Content: Amazon Kendra supports many file formats including PDF, HTML, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, plain text, and more. It can also index structured data from databases.

Title: Setting Up Your First Kendra Index
Content: To create your first Kendra index: 1) Open the AWS Console and navigate to Kendra, 2) Click Create Index, 3) Provide a name and IAM role, 4) Select the edition (Developer or Enterprise), 5) Wait for the index to become active.
